_about: Provenance record for everything vendored under lib/. This repository has no
.gitmodules and no package manager for Solidity dependencies: lib/ is a plain
copy of upstream source. This manifest is the only statement of where that
copy came from, and script/check-vendor-provenance.sh is the only thing that
proves the statement is still true.
Every pin below was established empirically (fetch upstream at the candidate
ref, `diff -r` against the vendored tree, iterate until the diff is empty) -
not asserted from package.json version strings. See the `verification` field
To update a dependency: re-vendor it, then update `ref` / `version` (and the
npm `integrity`) here in the same commit. CI will fail the PR otherwise.

local_modifications.reason: pragma relaxed 0.8.29 -> 0.8.28 (single token, line 3). This repo pins solc = 0.8.28 in foundry.toml, and a pinned solc overrides per-file compilation_restrictions in forge 1.7.1 - verified in isolation: a restriction requesting 0.8.29 fails with 'No solc version exists that matches'. The alternatives were unpinning the repo compiler (floats every caret-pragma test file onto a newer solc) or not compiling EAS here at all. EAS v1.4.0 uses no 0.8.29-only language feature and compiles clean at 0.8.28. Consequence: our bytecode is NOT identical to a canonical 0.8.29 EAS build - which is already true regardless, since this repo builds via_ir with optimizer_runs = 50 against upstream's 1,000,000.
